title: Have the Boomers Pinched Their Children’s Futures? - with Lord David Willetts
summary: Lord David Willetts argues at the Royal Institution that the post-war baby boomers gained wealth and security at the expense of younger generations. He draws on his book The Pinch, covering housing, wealth and social policy in the UK.
why: HN commenters point to it as a clear exposition of intergenerational unfairness in housing and wages, especially from a UK angle.

quote.text: One of the best expositions of the problem I've seen is this talk
